headline: Grigoriy Zatravkin climbs to 7th on ARC-3

sections.text: Grigoriy Zatravkin gained 4.39 to 45.02, moving from 10th to 7th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The move puts him among the board's 18 gold places.
